name: Chimichurri Sauce
notes: Great with rice and beans, and as rub and serving side with many meats.

items: 1 lemon wedge (or more), the entire thing including any seeds

steps.title: Blend
steps.body: Pulse together in a blender or food processor: **1 bunch flat leaf parsley**, **8 cloves garlic**, minced, **¾ cup olive oil**, **¼ cup red wine vinegar**, **1 lemon wedge** (or more), the entire thing including any seeds, **1 Tbsp diced red onion**, **1 tsp dried oregano** (optional), **¼ tsp cayenne** (optional), **1 tsp black pepper** and **½ tsp salt**.
